verdict.rationale: The docs claim a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, plus every config key usable as a CLI flag and 85 bindable actions. A hands-on runtime probe of Ghostty 1.3.1 found no remote-control or IPC interface, and reports that an external script or agent cannot send commands to, or read output from, a running instance. That directly contradicts the claimed scripting parity. Missing for 10: verified programmatic control of a running instance, a cross-platform (non-macOS) automation API, a way to read terminal output programmatically, and any documented parity between UI actions and an API.
